title: You can generate and edit Google Docs files directly in Gemini chats now
script:
Google Gemini now lets you generate and edit files directly in your chat window.
You can handle PDFs, Google Docs, Sheets, and slide decks without leaving the app.
The update also brings support for Markdown files, TXT files, and raw code.
These new capabilities are officially available to all Gemini users starting today.
PDF previews and editing work on both web and mobile devices.
However, those other file formats are only available on the web version.
Will you switch your workflow to Gemini for document drafting?
